Selection of a redevelopment plan for a central municipal park. A five-person review panel appointed by a city government examines the redevelopment plans prepared for a central park. ## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Kenji, Benjamin, Minato, Minako and Jonathan. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |

- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied candidates is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

After round 1, each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into. What they find out is told only to that participant.
